emma_cs: Quick intake: Northstar Logistics (ops@northstar) wants to onboard a custom manifest parser + redactor. Requirements: Private (customer VPC), HSM for keys, masking not deletion, and p95 <= 300ms for single-row lookups. They asked for an eval plan and to understand renewal implications if they need reserved capacity. Who can pick this up?
raj_se: I'll own SE. What framework/size and QPS?
emma_cs: They replied: PyTorch 2.0, ~5.1B, realtime single-row, QPS ~18 steady. Will provide artifacts + ~500 anonymized rows. NDA addendum requested for logs.
sophie_safety: Safety Qs: list of sensitive fields? Any PHI? We need adversarial redaction probes and extraction checks. Goal: FNR <1% on customer_id/container_id.
hugo_pm: Product constraints: ephemeral KV cache only, no persistent token logs. If we can't meet 300ms in their VPC we may recommend Dedicated which triggers commercial/reserved capacity talks. Tagging @noah_sales.
ticket_bot: onboard-bot: created ticket CS-12034 "northstar manifest redactor onboarding" https://redwood.atlassian.io/browse/CS-12034 :white_check_mark:
raj_se: Ops ask: send schema + 500 rows + target concurrency. Perf plan once data arrives: run cold/warm KV sweeps, try int8 quant, disable batching for latency. Example cmd:
`./perf --model northstar.pt --data samples.jsonl --qps 18 --concurrency 6 --quantize int8 --ephemeral-kv --out northstar_perf.json`
noah_sales: I'll prepare pricing for Dedicated + HSM scenarios and join the QBR. If they require reserved capacity that's a renewal upsell.
emma_cs: Thanks all 1 I'll request data + NDA addendum now and schedule a tech sync for Tue 11am PT. Will update CS-12034 when samples land. :thumbsup:
